note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of the front photo (43 mm case, listing; the photo is turned ~13 deg, horizontal sizes divided by cos_tilt). Heights before the house depth scale. Dial print, eagle logo, minute marks, date window and the purple-grey flange come from the dial map; the mesh bracelet from a repeating photo tile.

case.note: (r, z): matte gold aluminium case, straight flank under a thick domed bezel (19.24-21.5 mm in the photo) that drops into the groove at the crystal

dial.note: flat dial to 18.2 mm, then the purple-grey sloped flange up to the groove (photo map on both)

hour_bars.note: applied gold bars at every hour but 12 (the 12 mark is a short print under the logo)

hands.note: flat gold sticks with square ends, no tails; gold hub with a pin

arm.note: open wire lugs: one arm on each side from the case flank to the end cap ends, outline from the left silhouette, window between arm and case

end_cap.note: rectangular matte gold mesh clamp between the arm ends, 20.15 mm wide, 22.65-28.22 mm from the pivot

strap.note: Milanese-style gold mesh, photo tile repeating along the band; starts under the end cap. House curl (SUR419P1): bend at the end cap's outer edge (28.22 mm), 7 mm radius, end_y = tip + 2.2 x radius

gold_matte.note: gold tone aluminium, matte: case, bezel, arms, end caps

gold_polished.note: pale gold hands, hub and applied hour bars

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
